items.notes: TAO is about graph-store replica consistency; no first-order/total-order sensitivity shares. 'Consistency' is used in a different sense.
Decision-playbook method and safety gates only; no correlated-lag or reconciliation-capacity propagation in the V12 modernization scenario.
Kafka tier completeness auditing; no rollback-duration reporting, modeled drain, or end-of-horizon treatment.
Documents a coexistence-then-mandatory-cutover migration; does not explain why a no-cutover scenario is a reference case.
Runtime tracing, lineage and audit identifiers/hashes; not the V12 structural gate's identifier, link and hash checks.
Java service-platform convergence case; no replay environment capture or cross-platform guarantee limitation.
Deployment promotion, reconciliation and user-health gates; not the V12 independent review gate versus locally checked validation gates.
